name: arcadedb
description: Connect to your own ArcadeDB server through its built-in MCP endpoint: explore the schema, run Cypher/SQL/Gremlin queries, search vectors and full text, and update records within the permissions the server grants.

server_url.title: ArcadeDB server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your ArcadeDB server, without a trailing slash and without /api/v1/mcp, e.g. http://localhost:2480 or https://arcadedb.example.com

api_token.title: ArcadeDB API token
api_token.description: An API token created in ArcadeDB Studio (Security > API Tokens). Its 'apitoken:<name>' must be listed in the MCP allowed users (Server > MCP)
